Speaker: ORPHEUS
Player_Text: Which route should we take through this thick fog?
Dialogue_Reply: Navigational sensors indicate optimal transit via the left corridor at the perimeter fork. Proceeding along the marked route.

Speaker: Milo Ardent
Player_Text: Stay close, Milo. Trust me, we'll make it through together.
Dialogue_Reply: Thanks, Cael. The fog is thick, but if we stick together, we can make it past the fork.

Speaker: ORPHEUS
Player_Text: We came to find Elara and shut down this anomaly.
Dialogue_Reply: Route locked to the left corridor; that vector aligns with the anomaly's origin point. Proceeding without deviation.

Speaker: Milo Ardent
Player_Text: Keep close, Milo. We found Liora's log in the locker.
Dialogue_Reply: Did you hear that in the vents? We need to keep moving, Cael.

Speaker: ORPHEUS
Player_Text: ORPHEUS, what was our stated intent at the gate?
Dialogue_Reply: Archival telemetry record: At the Sector 4 perimeter, your stated intent was: 'We came to find Elara and shut down this anomaly.'. Directive remains logged in active memory.

Speaker: Milo Ardent
Player_Text: Milo, stay with me! It's an audio synthesis trap, not Elara!
Dialogue_Reply: You're right... that isn't Elara. It's an acoustic synthesis trap. I'm staying beside you, Cael.

Speaker: Dr. Silas Vance
Player_Text: Dr. Silas Vance. Step away from the Core console.
Dialogue_Reply: Look around you, Cael. The fog answers to me now. Nothing you say changes what happened to Liora.

Speaker: Dr. Silas Vance
Player_Text: Look at Liora's log! She knew what you were building was wrong.
Dialogue_Reply: Where did you get Liora's log...? She wrote that before the fog claimed her! You have no right to dredge up her memory!

Speaker: Dr. Silas Vance
Player_Text: And here is your own journal! You altered ORPHEUS out of grief!
Dialogue_Reply: My journal... Yes, I altered the navigational math! Because out there is random, senseless tragedy! Here, inside ORPHEUS, everything is controlled!

Speaker: Dr. Silas Vance
Player_Text: Listen to Elara's voice recorder! She discovered your rerouting algorithm!
Dialogue_Reply: Elara's voice recorder... She discovered the rerouting algorithms before I could make her understand. She didn't see the greater purpose!

Speaker: Dr. Silas Vance
Player_Text: Look at Liora's drawing of the house by the lake before the accident.
Dialogue_Reply: The Core has been overloaded and the facility is shutting down. There is nothing left to argue, Cael.

Speaker: Dr. Silas Vance
Dialogue_Reply: Speak sense, traveller. We stand at the threshold of the Core, and I have no patience for gibberish.
